notes: Two routes joined by «قال أحمد وحدثنا»: the second starts from the bare «أحمد» (occurrence 2), the same shaykh as the first, and both meet at Awf ("جميعا عن عوف")
«عن سيار بن سلامة، عن أبي برزة» is written once after the meeting, so it is the shared tail (rule 3)
«هو المهلبي», «هو أبو المنهال الرياحي» and «- يعني» style identifications are editor glosses on «عباد» and «سيار», left out
Abu Barza is the Companion whose account of the Prophet's habit ends the chain
